Patch Set 14:

(1 comment)
We should use existing or define a new D-Bus interface and association for Network Device Function.

Done. Using existing Item.NetworkInterface (from PDI) to identify NDF-capable ports. No new interface needed — ports with Item.NetworkInterface are treated as NetworkDeviceFunctions. Updated commit message to document this design.

See PS5:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5//COMMIT_MSG
nit: this doesn't need to be a separate function.

Done. Merged into afterGetNDFPortProtocol.

See PS5:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#60
use boost url format.

Done. Changed to boost::urls::format() for @odata.id URL.

See PS5:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#102
For errors other than boost::system::errc::io_error or EBADR, we should log error report messages::internalError. Same applies to other callback functions in this patch.

Done. Both afterGetNDFMacAddress and afterGetNDFPortProtocol now check EBADR first (early return), then log error and call messages::internalError for all other error codes.

See PS5:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#39
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#67
use boost url format.

Done. Changed to boost::urls::format().

See PS5:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#111
use std::format.

Done. Using std::format for display Name, boost::urls::format for @odata.id.

See PS5:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#107
use collection_utils function to populate members.

Done. Using collection_util::handleCollectionMembers().

See PS5:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#142
Shouldn't we use DBus interface for Network Device Function here instead of Connector.Port?

Done. Changed to use Item.NetworkInterface as the filter interface for both NDF Collection and individual NDF GET. The dbus-sensors side (88775 PS7) now exposes Item.NetworkInterface with MACAddress on each Ethernet port.

See PS5:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#171
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#189
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88775/7/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaEthPort.cpp#84
nit: move NetworkDeviceFunctions to separate file.

Done. Moved all NDF code to network_device_function.hpp, added #include and route registration in redfish.cpp.

See PS5:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/src/redfish.cpp#36
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/5/redfish-core/src/redfish.cpp#115
Is this include really needed?

It seems like we are looking for both the NetworkInteface and Port D-Bus interfaces to be present on the same object path. Let's not do that and use association to get list of `AssignablePhysicalNetworkPorts`.
Since we only need one property, see if we can use `getProperty` call.
See if we can use function `getNetworkAdapterPortPath` here. You would need to rename it to work with network device function and pass list of DBus interfaces as function parameter.
use sdbusplus::message::object_path operator /.
If you want to use this function here also, please rename it accordingly.
Done.

Done. NDF is now a separate D-Bus object with Item.NetworkInterface, linked via exposed_by/exposing (adapter) and assignable_physical_network_ports (port). bmcweb walks both to populate AssignablePhysicalNetworkPorts and NetDevFuncType.

Depends on PDI 89649 and dbus-sensors 88775 PS9.

PS7:
- adapter -> NDF walk: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#212
- NDF -> port walk: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#145
- afterGetAssignablePort: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#60

Done. Switched both PortProtocol and MACAddress reads to getProperty<std::string>.

PS7:
- PortProtocol: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#101
- MACAddress: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#139

Done. Renamed getNetworkAdapterPortPath -> getNetworkAdapterAssociatedSubResource; association name, endpoint interfaces, resource type/id are now parameters. NDF reuses the helper.

PS7:
- helper: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_adapter.hpp#253
- NDF caller: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#167
Looks like getNetworkAdapterPortPath was not used at all earlier, can you see of we can reuse newly added function `getNetworkAdapterAssociatedSubResource` anywhere in network_adapter.hpp as well?

Done. All association path construction uses sdbusplus::object_path operator /.

PS7:
- https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#145
- https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#212
- https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_adapter.hpp#263

Done. Renamed and reused -- see #178.

- NDF caller: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88776/7/redfish-core/lib/network_device_function.hpp#167
Please put the interface name directly instead of defining globals.
Done, thanks.

Done, thanks.
